production.direction_en: The Matron seals herself behind a glass ward and floods the chamber with corrosive vapor.
production.music_direction_en: pre: bgm_tension (glass harmonics) | battle: bgm_boss_human (alchemist variation) | post: bgm_warmth (Kera stays)

commands.speaker: red_vial_matron
commands.text: The heir’s blood is not a cure. It is the last ingredient.

commands.speaker: kera_voss
commands.text: I knew the Guild was using the wrong formula. I did not know it was using her.

commands.speaker: fadyme
commands.text: Break the flasks. Do not let her finish the sentence.
